title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Mr. Perfect
desc: Vicky breaks his engagement with Priya, his childhood friend, after he learns that she is making many compromises for his sake. However, time makes him realise the need for compromises in life.

title: Love Birds
desc: Mridula relocates to the UK to nurse her broken heart after her lover Arun dies. However, when she meets a man who looks exactly like him, she tries to find his true identity.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.
